physical: The entropy of a macrostate is Boltzmann's constant times the logarithm of the number of microstates that realize it. (S = k × ln W)
reflected_formula: Culmination (provisional) = [unmapped: Boltzmann constant k] × ln [unmapped: number of microstates W]
reflected_sentence: The Culmination (provisional) of a [unmapped: macrostate] is [unmapped: Boltzmann constant k] times the logarithm of the [unmapped: number of microstates W] in its realization.
rule_reason: definition with zero costs caused by resistance and no separation made by distance
interpretation: Entropy maps to Culmination (provisional), and how states realize a condition touches realization, but Boltzmann constant and the number of microstates have no partners. Because nothing on the nonphysical side has a number or a unit, counting microstates cannot cross the Point of Reflection. The definition keeps its shape mechanically while leaving Culmination tied to an unmapped count.
conflicts: "Nothing on the nonphysical side has a number, a unit or a distance."
closing: The rule decided on its own: the relation is a definition and none of its three quantities (entropy, number of microstates, Boltzmann constant) carries resistance or distance. The reflection still stalls on vocabulary and traps because W is an explicit count (a number) and k is a dimensional constant, neither of which has a nonphysical partner.
